expected_value_creation: A traceable intervention and recovery chain makes operational response evidence reviewable without transferring authority to QIF
beneficiary: operators, governance owners, and affected stakeholders
supporting_evidence: Current primary guidance calls for trajectory intervention, response SLAs, fail-closed controls, rollback ability, and recovery monitoring
success_criteria: QIF reproduces authority, SLA, reversibility, rollback, recovery checks, residual risk, and governance routing
